hook: Yadadri plant's *5th* 800 MW unit set for December
hook_b: Yadadri plant's *5th* 800 MW unit set for December
tldr: The 5x800 MW Yadadri Thermal Power Station at Damaracherla, Nalgonda, expects its fifth unit to begin commercial operations next month. Four units already run. TG-Genco aims for the full 4,000 MW through the rabi and summer season.

beats.what: The fifth unit was synchronised with the grid on Oct 20 and is expected to reach commercial operation date in December.
beats.why: Telangana's peak demand is rising; TG-Genco wants all five units running through the coming rabi and summer season.
beats.care: More in-state generation going into summer, when Hyderabad's demand peaks.

causes.label: Fifth unit synced to grid Oct 20

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu (Nov 18): a BHEL and TG-Genco team camped at the plant to fix coal-handling issues; boiler, turbine and generator systems are working, officials say.

cards.q: Did your area face power cuts last summer?

qs: How much of Telangana's summer peak can Yadadri alone cover?

facts.t: Four restored coal lines feed about *3,200 tonnes* an hour, 800 each.

viz.verdict: Fifth 800 MW unit due next month
Delayed by COVID, clearances and NGT directions

watch: The fifth unit's commercial operation date in December and summer 2027 peak demand.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana's YTPS final unit commercial operations likely in December 2026

fact: Yadadri thermal plant's fifth unit may start commercial power in *December*
twist: A coal-handling glitch had to be fixed first: four feed lines now move 3,200 tonnes an hour.
